svg.title: Video transcoding pipeline architecture on AWS
svg.desc: AWS architecture for a YouTube-like pipeline: CloudFront CDN for HLS and thumbnails, S3 storage, ECS workers, SQS, RDS, and API Gateway
svg.text: Stores: users · videos · jobs · transcodes · email verification tokens
RDS Proxy sits between ECS and DB — prevents connection exhaustion
Worker: read raw → write HLS under hls/{videoId}/ + poster at 00:00:05 → notify via SQS
Clients stream via CloudFront; uploads stay presigned PUT direct to S3 (provisioned in CloudFormation repo)
